pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ bhattena nimantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto purebhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū te manusse etadavocuṃ;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.7: āgametha bhante yāva ayyo upanando āgacchatīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.9: tatiyampi kho te bhikkhū te manusse etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.11: yampi mayaṃ bhante bhattaṃ karimhā ayyassa upanandassa kāraṇā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.12: āgametha bhante yāva ayyo upanando āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.13: atha kho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto purebhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsitvā divā āgañchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.15: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.20: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:1.24: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ saṅghassa atthāya khādanīyaṃ pāhesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.4: atha kho te manussā ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhū pucchiṃsu:–
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.6: esāvuso āyasmā upanando sakyaputto gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.7: idaṃ, bhante khādanīyaṃ ayyassa upanandassa dassetvā saṅghassa dātabbanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.10: tena hi bhikkhave paṭiggahetvā nikkhipatha yāva upanando āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.11: atha kho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ purebhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjitunti. pacchābhattaṃ kulāni payirupāsitvā divā pakkāmi, khādanīyaṃ ussādiyittha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.12: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.13: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto pacchābhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.14: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda pacchābhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.17: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pacchābhattaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.19: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.20.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:2.21: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvaradānasamaye kukkuccāyantā kulāni na payirupāsanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.5: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo cīvaradānasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:3.8: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karonti. attho ca hoti sūciyāpi suttenapi satthakenapi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.5: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā pācittiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo cīvaradānasamayo, cīvarakārasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:4.8: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti attho ca hoti bhesajjehi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave santaṃ bhikkhuṃ āpucchā kulāni payirupāsituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.5: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.6.1: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya, aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:5.7: tatthāyaṃ samayo: cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo, ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.16: yena nimantito taṃ antamaso aruṇuggamanepi bhuttaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.18: cattāri kulāni khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.21: paṭhamaṃ pādaṃ ummāraṃ atikkāmeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.1.26: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso. atthate kaṭhine pañcamāsā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.2.1: nimantite nimantitasaññī santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati, aññatra samayā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.2.2: nimantite vematiko santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati aññatra samayā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc46:6.2.3: nimantite animantitasaññī santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati aññatra samayā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
